description: This source file defines a custom annotation @JsonParsableEvent used to mark classes as deserializable from JSON in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes metadata such as the command name, type prefix, and method name for deserialization.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the command associated with the event.

methods.name: typePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of the event.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the name of the method used to deserialize the event from JSON, defaults to 'fromJson'.
